msg_calibration_timeout.english: The calibration did not finish. Try again.

auto_detect_active_toggle.english: Auto-detect active: toggle desired AUX channel

msg_auto_detect_lock_first.english: Auto-detect is active for this row. Toggle to lock AUX first.
msg_auto_detect_lock_first.translation: Auto-detect actief voor deze rij. Schakel om AUX eerst te

msg_auto_detect_lock_save.english: Auto-detect is active. Toggle the desired AUX channel first.
msg_auto_detect_lock_save.translation: Auto-detect actief. Schakel eerst het gewenste AUX-kanaal.

msg_reset_tail_view.english: Reset view yaw so the rear faces you?
msg_reset_tail_view.translation: Reset view yaw so the rear faces you?

help_p1.english: Copy PID profile or Rate profile from Source to Destination.
help_p1.translation: Kopieer PID-profiel of Rate-profiel van Bron naar

help_p2.english: Choose the source and destinations and save to copy the profile.
help_p2.translation: Kies bron en bestemmingen en sla op om profiel te kopiëren.

msgbox_copy_fmt.english: Copy %s Profile %d to Profile %d? This permanently overwrites Profile %d in the controller.
msgbox_copy_fmt.translation: Copy %s Profile %d to Profile %d? This permanently overwrites Profile %d in the controller.

confirm_prompt.english: Apply packet rate and telemetry ratio changes to the RF module / controller?
confirm_prompt.translation: Apply packet rate and telemetry ratio changes to the RF module / controller?

status_gr_config_not_ready.english: Gripora telemetry config was not ready

status_requires_active_link.english: This tool requires an active CRSF link

motor_override_disable_msg.english: Return control of the motor to the controller.
motor_override_disable_msg.translation: Return control of the motor to the controller.

motor_override_enable_msg.english: The controller drives the motor directly. Lift the wheels off the ground, secure the car and stand clear.
motor_override_enable_msg.translation: The controller drives the motor directly. Lift the wheels off the ground, secure the car and stand clear.

motor_override_note.english: Wheels off the ground and the car secured.
motor_override_note.translation: Wheels off the ground and the car secured.

motor_override_note_2.english: The motor turns with the throttle.
motor_override_note_2.translation: The motor turns with the throttle.

error_back.translation: Pdruk op BACK om terug te keren.

error_busy.english: MSP queue is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
error_busy.translation: MSP-wachtrij is bezet. Wacht even en probeer het opnieuw.

error_check_power.english: Check ESC power and wiring, then try again.
error_check_power.translation: Controleer de voeding en bedrading van de ESC en probeer het vervolgens opnieuw.

error_choose_esc.english: Use the matching ESC manufacturer page.

extra_msg_save.english: Please reboot the ESC to apply the changes
extra_msg_save.translation: Herstart de ESC om de wijzigingen op te slaan

msg_no_columns.english: No plottable columns in this file

auto_detect_active.english: Auto-detect active: toggle desired AUX channel
auto_detect_active.translation: Auto-detectie actief: schakel het gewenste AUX-kanaal

msg_auto_detect_lock_first.english: Auto-detect is active for this row. Toggle to lock AUX first.
msg_auto_detect_lock_first.translation: Automatische detectie is actief voor deze rij. Schakel om eerst AUX te vergrendelen.

msg_auto_detect_lock_save.english: Auto-detect is active. Toggle the desired AUX channel first.
msg_auto_detect_lock_save.translation: Automatische detectie is actief. Schakel eerst naar het gewenste AUX-kanaal.

msg_no_free_slots.english: No free mode slots remain. Delete an existing range first.
msg_no_free_slots.translation: Er zijn geen slots in de vrije modus meer. Verwijder eerst een bestaand bereik.

no_ranges.english: No ranges configured for this mode.
no_ranges.translation: Er zijn geen bereiken geconfigureerd voor deze modus.

start_prompt.english: Would you like to start the test? Choose the test run time below.

no_ports_reported.english: No serial ports reported by FC.
no_ports_reported.translation: Geen seriële poorten gerapporteerd door FC.

save_armed.english: Saved; written to flash on disarm
save_armed.translation: Saved; written to flash on disarm

not_configured.english: No port is assigned the backup RX function.
not_configured.translation: No port is assigned the backup RX function.

disable_servo_override_msg.english: Return control of the servos to the controller.
disable_servo_override_msg.translation: Return control of the servos to the controller.

enable_servo_override_msg.english: Servo override allows you to 'trim' your servo center point in real time.
enable_servo_override_msg.translation: Servo overschrijven Hiermee kunt u het middelpunt van uw servo in realtime 'trimmen'.

no_themes_available_to_configure.english: No configurable themes installed on this device
no_themes_available_to_configure.translation: Geen themes beschikbaar om in te stellen

air_custom.english: This car uses a custom mix from Mixer Rules. Choose Car to replace it, or keep it and carry on.
air_custom.translation: This car uses a custom mix from Mixer Rules. Choose Car to replace it, or keep it and carry on.

air_edited.english: The rules have been changed by hand and no longer match a car setup. Change options rebuilds them.
air_edited.translation: The rules have been changed by hand and no longer match a car setup. Change options rebuilds them.

air_intro.english: Choose Car for a car with steering and an ESC, with optional rear steering and a second ESC. Choose Custom to keep a mix built by hand in Mixer Rules.
air_intro.translation: Choose Car for a car with steering and an ESC, with optional rear steering and a second ESC. Choose Custom to keep a mix built by hand in Mixer Rules.

air_q_amount_fmt.english: How far the rear wheels turn compared with the front ones: %d%%.
air_q_amount_fmt.translation: How far the rear wheels turn compared with the front ones: %d%%.

air_q_second_esc.english: A second ESC (dual motor, or front and rear motors)? It gets the same throttle as M1, forward, brake and reverse.
air_q_second_esc.translation: A second ESC (dual motor, or front and rear motors)? It gets the same throttle as M1, forward, brake and reverse.

air_rear_help.english: Opposite to the front wheels: tighter turns. The same way: crab steering.
air_rear_help.translation: Opposite to the front wheels: tighter turns. The same way: crab steering.

air_too_few_fmt.english: It needs %d servo outputs and this board has %d. The servos past them won't move.
air_too_few_fmt.translation: It needs %d servo outputs and this board has %d. The servos past them won't move.

armed.english: Armed: the steering can't be moved.
armed.translation: Armed: the steering can't be moved.

bus_changed.english: The change takes effect after a restart.
bus_changed.translation: The change takes effect after a restart.

bus_channels_help.english: The highest servo number the bus carries.
bus_channels_help.translation: The highest servo number the bus carries.

bus_fbus_help.english: Servos and sensors answer, so the wiring can be checked.
bus_fbus_help.translation: Servos and sensors answer, so the wiring can be checked.

bus_fbus_signal.english: With the bus powered, its F.Bus servos and sensors should answer within a few seconds.
bus_fbus_signal.translation: With the bus powered, its F.Bus servos and sensors should answer within a few seconds.

bus_found.english: Found it. The bus answers on this wiring, which is now in use. Save to keep it.
bus_found.translation: Found it. The bus answers on this wiring, which is now in use. Save to keep it.

bus_intro.english: Optional. Servos on an F.Bus or SBUS line plug into a serial port, not the servo pins. Which port is the bus on?
bus_intro.translation: Optional. Servos on an F.Bus or SBUS line plug into a serial port, not the servo pins. Which port is the bus on?

bus_no_answer.english: Nothing answering. The bus may be on the port's other pin.
bus_no_answer.translation: Nothing answering. The bus may be on the port's other pin.

bus_no_answer_detect.english: Nothing answering. Detect wiring tries each pin and polarity.
bus_no_answer_detect.translation: Nothing answering. Detect wiring tries each pin and polarity.

bus_not_found.english: Nothing answered on any wiring. Check the bus has power and is plugged into this port.
bus_not_found.translation: Nothing answered on any wiring. Check the bus has power and is plugged into this port.

bus_pin_fixed.english: This firmware can't switch the pin from here.
bus_pin_fixed.translation: This firmware can't switch the pin from here.

bus_proto_fmt.english: The bus is on %s. Servo 1 is channel 1 on the bus, servo 2 is channel 2, and so on.
bus_proto_fmt.translation: The bus is on %s. Servo 1 is channel 1 on the bus, servo 2 is channel 2, and so on.

bus_rejected.english: The controller can't test the wiring now: the car is armed, or the board has an F.Bus mux.
bus_rejected.translation: The controller can't test the wiring now: the car is armed, or the board has an F.Bus mux.

bus_rx_pin_fmt.english: F.Bus is on the RX pin of %s.
bus_rx_pin_fmt.translation: F.Bus is on the RX pin of %s.

bus_sbus_help.english: One-way. Checked later, when each servo is moved.
bus_sbus_help.translation: One-way. Checked later, when each servo is moved.

bus_sbus_signal.english: SBUS is sent on the port's TX pin. Nothing answers on SBUS, so check it in the later steps, where each servo is moved.
bus_sbus_signal.translation: SBUS is sent on the port's TX pin. Nothing answers on SBUS, so check it in the later steps, where each servo is moved.

bus_tx_pin_fmt.english: F.Bus is on the TX pin of %s.
bus_tx_pin_fmt.translation: F.Bus is on the TX pin of %s.

bus_wiring_ok.english: The bus answers on the wiring already set.
bus_wiring_ok.translation: The bus answers on the wiring already set.

cen_done.english: Every steering servo is at its center.
cen_done.translation: Every steering servo is at its center.

cen_far.english: Far from the servo's normal center. Move the horn instead, or this side loses travel.
cen_far.translation: Far from the servo's normal center. Move the horn instead, or this side loses travel.

cen_intro.english: The steering is held at center. First set the servo horn and linkage so the wheels point close to straight ahead, then fine-tune the center here.
cen_intro.translation: The steering is held at center. First set the servo horn and linkage so the wheels point close to straight ahead, then fine-tune the center here.

dir_cant_fix_fmt.english: Servo %s also works another axis, so reversing it would break that one. Change its mix in Mixer Rules.
dir_cant_fix_fmt.translation: Servo %s also works another axis, so reversing it would break that one. Change its mix in Mixer Rules.

dir_done_ok.english: The steering turns the right way.
dir_done_ok.translation: The steering turns the right way.

dir_expect_yaw.english: The front wheels steer right. With rear steering, the rear wheels steer left when set to opposite, or right when set to the same direction.
dir_expect_yaw.translation: The front wheels steer right. With rear steering, the rear wheels steer left when set to opposite, or right when set to the same direction.

dir_identify_fmt.english: Servo %d (%s) is wiggling now, %d of %d. Did it move the wrong way?
dir_identify_fmt.translation: Servo %d (%s) is wiggling now, %d of %d. Did it move the wrong way?

dir_intro.english: Hands off the radio. The wizard turns the steering itself, and the wheel and trigger do nothing. Watch the wheels and say whether they move the way the picture shows.
dir_intro.translation: Hands off the radio. The wizard turns the steering itself, and the wheel and trigger do nothing. Watch the wheels and say whether they move the way the picture shows.

dir_q_all.english: Did every steering servo move the wrong way?
dir_q_all.translation: Did every steering servo move the wrong way?

dir_q_match.english: Do the wheels move like the picture?
dir_q_match.translation: Do the wheels move like the picture?

esc_battery_text.english: The ESC can measure the battery in place of the controller's own sensors.
esc_battery_text.translation: The ESC can measure the battery in place of the controller's own sensors.

esc_castle.english: Castle Link reads telemetry on the throttle wire, so it needs no port.
esc_castle.translation: Castle Link reads telemetry on the throttle wire, so it needs no port.

esc_changed.english: The change takes effect after a restart.
esc_changed.translation: The change takes effect after a restart.

esc_elsewhere_fmt.english: ESC telemetry is set to %s, which does not use an ESC telemetry port. Change it in the Configurator.
esc_elsewhere_fmt.translation: ESC telemetry is set to %s, which does not use an ESC telemetry port. Change it in the Configurator.

esc_found.english: The ESC answers on a different wiring. Save and restart to use it.
esc_found.translation: The ESC answers on a different wiring. Save and restart to use it.

esc_intro.english: Optional. An ESC with a telemetry wire can send voltage, current, temperature and RPM to a serial port.
esc_intro.translation: Optional. An ESC with a telemetry wire can send voltage, current, temperature and RPM to a serial port.

esc_no_motor.english: No motor is set up on the ESC step, so there is no ESC telemetry to set up.
esc_no_motor.translation: No motor is set up on the ESC step, so there is no ESC telemetry to set up.

esc_no_reply.english: The controller did not answer. Try again.
esc_no_reply.translation: The controller did not answer. Try again.

esc_not_found.english: No answer from the ESC. Check that it is powered, and the wire, port and protocol.
esc_not_found.translation: No answer from the ESC. Check that it is powered, and the wire, port and protocol.

esc_not_used_help.english: No telemetry wire from the ESC.
esc_not_used_help.translation: No telemetry wire from the ESC.

esc_port_fmt.english: Which port is the %s telemetry wire plugged into? Ports in use are greyed out.
esc_port_fmt.translation: Which port is the %s telemetry wire plugged into? Ports in use are greyed out.

esc_protocol_help.english: The make of your ESC. Its manual says which telemetry it sends.
esc_protocol_help.translation: The make of your ESC. Its manual says which telemetry it sends.

esc_rejected.english: The controller can't test this wiring. Disarm, and check the port and protocol.
esc_rejected.translation: The controller can't test this wiring. Disarm, and check the port and protocol.

esc_use_current.english: Use the ESC's current and mAh used.
esc_use_current.translation: Use the ESC's current and mAh used.

esc_use_voltage.english: Use the ESC's voltage for the battery.
esc_use_voltage.translation: Use the ESC's voltage for the battery.

esc_wiring_ok.english: The ESC answers. The wiring is right.
esc_wiring_ok.translation: The ESC answers. The wiring is right.

esc_wiring_text.english: Power the ESC, then press Detect wiring. The controller tries each way the wire can be connected until the ESC answers.
esc_wiring_text.translation: Power the ESC, then press Detect wiring. The controller tries each way the wire can be connected until the ESC answers.

fin_before.english: Before the first run: with the wheels off the ground, check forward throttle drives the wheels forward; with GYRO OFF mode off, steer and turn the car by hand: the wheels follow the steering and steer against the movement; do a range check.
fin_before.translation: Before the first run: with the wheels off the ground, check forward throttle drives the wheels forward; with GYRO OFF mode off, steer and turn the car by hand: the wheels follow the steering and steer against the movement; do a range check.

fin_intro.english: That's the setup done. Here is what the wizard set.
fin_intro.translation: That's the setup done. Here is what the wizard set.

gyr_check_again.english: This works straight away. Turn the car by hand again and answer the check.
gyr_check_again.translation: This works straight away. Turn the car by hand again and answer the check.

gyr_done.english: The gyro steers against the turn.
gyr_done.translation: The gyro steers against the turn.

gyr_intro.english: Now the gyro drives the steering. With the wheels off the ground, turn the car by hand around its vertical axis and check the steering pushes against the movement.
gyr_intro.translation: Now the gyro drives the steering. With the wheels off the ground, turn the car by hand around its vertical axis and check the steering pushes against the movement.

gyr_reverse_auto.english: Reverse needs no setup: when the car drives backwards, the controller turns the gyro correction round by itself.
gyr_reverse_auto.translation: Reverse needs no setup: when the car drives backwards, the controller turns the gyro correction round by itself.

gyr_standstill_fmt.english: With motor RPM, the gyro only corrects once the car is moving (from %.1f km/h), so at a standstill the steering doesn't answer when you turn the car by hand. That isn't the wrong direction: check it on the first drive.
gyr_standstill_fmt.translation: With motor RPM, the gyro only corrects once the car is moving (from %.1f km/h), so at a standstill the steering doesn't answer when you turn the car by hand. That isn't the wrong direction: check it on the first drive.

gyr_wrong.english: If the steering was right in the Steering direction step but corrects the wrong way here, the gyro reads the car's turning backwards for this mounting. Reverse the gyro. Don't reverse the servo: that would reverse the steering on the radio too.
gyr_wrong.translation: If the steering was right in the Steering direction step but corrects the wrong way here, the gyro reads the car's turning backwards for this mounting. Reverse the gyro. Don't reverse the servo: that would reverse the steering on the radio too.

gyr_wrong_old.english: If the steering was right in the Steering direction step but corrects the wrong way here, the gyro reads the car's turning backwards for this mounting. This firmware can't reverse the gyro on its own: update the firmware, then reverse it here. Don't reverse the servo.
gyr_wrong_old.translation: If the steering was right in the Steering direction step but corrects the wrong way here, the gyro reads the car's turning backwards for this mounting. This firmware can't reverse the gyro on its own: update the firmware, then reverse it here. Don't reverse the servo.

gyr_yaw.english: Turn the car clockwise (nose to the right, seen from above): the front wheels steer left, against the turn.
gyr_yaw.translation: Turn the car clockwise (nose to the right, seen from above): the front wheels steer left, against the turn.

leave_body.english: Save the wizard's changes to the controller, or discard them?
leave_body.translation: Save the wizard's changes to the controller, or discard them?

lim_done.english: Every servo has its limits. A side you skipped keeps its old limit.
lim_done.translation: Every servo has its limits. A side you skipped keeps its old limit.

lim_intro.english: Find how far each servo can move before the steering or linkage binds, one side per screen. These limits protect the servo; set how far the wheels turn in Mixer Rules, not here.
lim_intro.translation: Find how far each servo can move before the steering or linkage binds, one side per screen. These limits protect the servo; set how far the wheels turn in Mixer Rules, not here.

lim_todo_max.english: Press + until the steering binds, back off one step, then Set. Next skips this side.
lim_todo_max.translation: Press + until the steering binds, back off one step, then Set. Next skips this side.

lim_todo_min.english: Press - until the steering binds, back off one step, then Set. Next skips this side.
lim_todo_min.translation: Press - until the steering binds, back off one step, then Set. Next skips this side.

missing_servos_fmt.english: Servo %s is mixed but this board has no output for it, so the wizard leaves it out.
missing_servos_fmt.translation: Servo %s is mixed but this board has no output for it, so the wizard leaves it out.

mod_arm_missing.english: ARM isn't on a switch yet: without it the motor can't be armed and the car can't drive.
mod_arm_missing.translation: ARM isn't on a switch yet: without it the motor can't be armed and the car can't drive.

mod_arm_on.english: The ARM switch is on. Switch it off before you carry on.
mod_arm_on.translation: The ARM switch is on. Switch it off before you carry on.

mod_flick.english: Flick the switch to the on position now...
mod_flick.translation: Flick the switch to the on position now...

mod_help_arm.english: Arms the motor. Nothing else works without it.
mod_help_arm.translation: Arms the motor. Nothing else works without it.

mod_help_drive_aids_off.english: Turns ABS, traction and launch control off: throttle and brake go straight to the ESC. The gyro still steers.
mod_help_drive_aids_off.translation: Turns ABS, traction and launch control off: throttle and brake go straight to the ESC. The gyro still steers.

mod_help_gyro_off.english: Turns the gyro off: steering and throttle pass straight from the transmitter, with no gyro correction. Put it on a switch you can reach while driving.
mod_help_gyro_off.translation: Turns the gyro off: steering and throttle pass straight from the transmitter, with no gyro correction. Put it on a switch you can reach while driving.

mod_help_launch.english: Stages a launch for launch control: turn it on at the line, and the first pull of the trigger launches the car. Set it up under Tuning, Launch.
mod_help_launch.translation: Stages a launch for launch control: turn it on at the line, and the first pull of the trigger launches the car. Set it up under Tuning, Launch.

mod_intro.english: Put modes on switches: press Assign, then flick the switch to the position that turns the mode on. Only ARM is required; you can change modes later on the Modes page.
mod_intro.translation: Put modes on switches: press Assign, then flick the switch to the position that turns the mode on. Only ARM is required; you can change modes later on the Modes page.

mod_no_slot.english: Every mode slot is in use. Free one on the Modes page.
mod_no_slot.translation: Every mode slot is in use. Free one on the Modes page.

mot_changed.english: The new protocol takes effect after a restart.
mot_changed.translation: The new protocol takes effect after a restart.

mot_dshot150_help.english: Digital, tolerant of long leads. No bidirectional RPM.
mot_dshot150_help.translation: Digital, tolerant of long leads. No bidirectional RPM.

mot_dshot150_rpm.english: Motor RPM needs DShot300 or an RPM or ESC telemetry source.
mot_dshot150_rpm.translation: Motor RPM needs DShot300 or an RPM or ESC telemetry source.

mot_dshot300_help.english: Digital, no calibration; BLHeli, Bluejay, AM32.
mot_dshot300_help.translation: Digital, no calibration; BLHeli, Bluejay, AM32.

mot_dshot600_help.english: Faster DShot, for ESCs that support it.
mot_dshot600_help.translation: Faster DShot, for ESCs that support it.

mot_esc_mode_auto_help.english: Let the controller decide from the protocol: DShot reverses directly, PWM brakes first.
mot_esc_mode_auto_help.translation: Let the controller decide from the protocol: DShot reverses directly, PWM brakes first.

mot_esc_mode_fwd_brk_help.english: The ESC brakes but never reverses.
mot_esc_mode_fwd_brk_help.translation: The ESC brakes but never reverses.

mot_esc_mode_fwd_brk_rev_help.english: Brakes, then reverses after the throttle returns to neutral. Most car ESCs; AM32 with RC car reverse on.
mot_esc_mode_fwd_brk_rev_help.translation: Brakes, then reverses after the throttle returns to neutral. Most car ESCs; AM32 with RC car reverse on.

mot_esc_mode_fwd_rev_help.english: Reverses as soon as the throttle goes below neutral. AM32's default bidirectional mode; DShot.
mot_esc_mode_fwd_rev_help.translation: Reverses as soon as the throttle goes below neutral. AM32's default bidirectional mode; DShot.

mot_esc_mode_tell.english: Not sure? On the direction check, run Forward, then Reverse straight away. If the wheels only stop, and turn backwards only on a second Reverse, choose Brake, then reverse.
mot_esc_mode_tell.translation: Not sure? On the direction check, run Forward, then Reverse straight away. If the wheels only stop, and turn backwards only on a second Reverse, choose Brake, then reverse.

mot_intro.english: How the controller talks to the ESC. Then check how it reverses, neutral and the motor direction.
mot_intro.translation: How the controller talks to the ESC. Then check how it reverses, neutral and the motor direction.

mot_neutral_check.english: With the throttle trigger at centre the wheels must not turn. The car only arms with the throttle at neutral.
mot_neutral_check.translation: With the throttle trigger at centre the wheels must not turn. The car only arms with the throttle at neutral.

mot_neutral_intro_fmt.english: The controller sends neutral to the ESC as %d us. Calibrate the ESC with its neutral there (its throttle calibration, with the throttle trigger centred), or the car creeps or brakes with the trigger at centre.
mot_neutral_intro_fmt.translation: The controller sends neutral to the ESC as %d us. Calibrate the ESC with its neutral there (its throttle calibration, with the throttle trigger centred), or the car creeps or brakes with the trigger at centre.

mot_no_outputs.english: This board has no motor output set up.
mot_no_outputs.translation: This board has no motor output set up.

mot_no_rpm_note.english: Without motor RPM the controller can't tell when the car is stopped, so the gyro stays fully active at a standstill. For the best low-speed and reverse behaviour, use an ESC with RPM telemetry or a speed sensor.
mot_no_rpm_note.translation: Without motor RPM the controller can't tell when the car is stopped, so the gyro stays fully active at a standstill. For the best low-speed and reverse behaviour, use an ESC with RPM telemetry or a speed sensor.

mot_other_help.english: No motor, DShot600 (short ESC leads only) and the rest.
mot_other_help.translation: No motor, DShot600 (short ESC leads only) and the rest.

mot_pwm_help.english: Works with any car ESC. The ESC learns neutral and the throttle range in its own calibration.
mot_pwm_help.translation: Works with any car ESC. The ESC learns neutral and the throttle range in its own calibration.

mot_spin_text.english: It runs for a few seconds and stops by itself, or within a second if the link drops. Forward must turn the wheels forward and Reverse backward (many ESCs brake first: run Reverse again). If they turn the wrong way, reverse the motor in the ESC's settings, or swap the two wires of a brushed motor.
mot_spin_text.translation: It runs for a few seconds and stops by itself, or within a second if the link drops. Forward must turn the wheels forward and Reverse backward (many ESCs brake first: run Reverse again). If they turn the wrong way, reverse the motor in the ESC's settings, or swap the two wires of a brushed motor.

mot_spin_twin.english: One motor runs at a time: check which ESC is which.
mot_spin_twin.translation: One motor runs at a time: check which ESC is which.

mot_wheels_text.english: The motor is about to run. Put the car on a stand, so its wheels are off the ground.
mot_wheels_text.translation: The motor is about to run. Put the car on a stand, so its wheels are off the ground.

needs_firmware.english: The Setup Wizard needs controller firmware with MSP API 33.0 or newer, which can hold the steering safely. Update the firmware, or use the Configurator.
needs_firmware.translation: The Setup Wizard needs controller firmware with MSP API 33.0 or newer, which can hold the steering safely. Update the firmware, or use the Configurator.

no_surfaces.english: No steering servo is mixed yet. Choose Car on the Model step, then come back.
no_surfaces.translation: No steering servo is mixed yet. Choose Car on the Model step, then come back.

refused.english: Disarm: the controller refused setup mode.
refused.translation: Disarm: the controller refused setup mode.

rx_car_hint.english: Car radios send CH1 steering, CH2 throttle.
rx_car_hint.translation: Car radios send CH1 steering, CH2 throttle.

rx_check_car.english: Turn the wheel full left and push the trigger to full brake. Both bars should go left.
rx_check_car.translation: Turn the wheel full left and push the trigger to full brake. Both bars should go left.

rx_move_steering.english: Turn the steering wheel all the way, and leave the trigger still.
rx_move_steering.translation: Turn the steering wheel all the way, and leave the trigger still.

rx_move_trigger.english: Pull the throttle trigger all the way, and leave the wheel still.
rx_move_trigger.translation: Pull the throttle trigger all the way, and leave the wheel still.

rx_reversed.english: A bar going right is reversed: reverse that channel on your radio, not here.
rx_reversed.translation: A bar going right is reversed: reverse that channel on your radio, not here.

sen_acc_failed.english: The calibration did not finish. Try again.
sen_acc_failed.translation: The calibration did not finish. Try again.

sen_acc_text.english: Hold the car level and still, then press Calibrate.
sen_acc_text.translation: Hold the car level and still, then press Calibrate.

sen_align_done_fmt.english: Board orientation found: roll %d, pitch %d, yaw %d degrees.
sen_align_done_fmt.translation: Board orientation found: roll %d, pitch %d, yaw %d degrees.

sen_align_lift.english: Now lift the rear by at least 20 degrees and hold it...
sen_align_lift.translation: Now lift the rear by at least 20 degrees and hold it...

sen_align_text.english: Place the car flat, press Start, then lift the rear by at least 20 degrees.
sen_align_text.translation: Place the car flat, press Start, then lift the rear by at least 20 degrees.

sen_check_text.english: Tilt the car right and left, then nose down and up: the picture must follow every movement. If it doesn't, go back and find the orientation again.
sen_check_text.translation: Tilt the car right and left, then nose down and up: the picture must follow every movement. If it doesn't, go back and find the orientation again.

sen_done_restart.english: The controller restarts to use the new orientation and level. The wizard carries on afterwards.
sen_done_restart.translation: The controller restarts to use the new orientation and level. The wizard carries on afterwards.

sen_intro.english: The controller needs to know how it is mounted and which way is level. Power on with the car still: the gyro calibrates itself at power-up.
sen_intro.translation: The controller needs to know how it is mounted and which way is level. Power on with the car still: the gyro calibrates itself at power-up.

sen_level_done_fmt.english: Mounting trim set: roll %.1f, pitch %.1f degrees.
sen_level_done_fmt.translation: Mounting trim set: roll %.1f, pitch %.1f degrees.

sen_level_text.english: Set the car on its wheels on a level surface and keep it still while it measures.
sen_level_text.translation: Set the car on its wheels on a level surface and keep it still while it measures.

sen_no_acc.english: No accelerometer found, so the board orientation and level can't be set here.
sen_no_acc.translation: No accelerometer found, so the board orientation and level can't be set here.

sen_no_match.english: No orientation matched. Lift the rear further and keep the car level side to side.
sen_no_match.translation: No orientation matched. Lift the rear further and keep the car level side to side.

sen_out_of_range.english: The car is too far from level. Set it on a level surface.
sen_out_of_range.translation: The car is too far from level. Set it on a level surface.

sen_timeout.english: Nothing was measured in time. Try again.
sen_timeout.translation: Nothing was measured in time. Try again.

sen_unsupported.english: This firmware can't do this automatically. Set it on the Alignment page.
sen_unsupported.translation: This firmware can't do this automatically. Set it on the Alignment page.

st_all.english: Applies to every servo on a PWM output.
st_all.translation: Applies to every servo on a PWM output.

st_analog_help.english: 50 Hz, works with any standard servo.
st_analog_help.translation: 50 Hz, works with any standard servo.

st_applied_fmt.english: %s set on every PWM servo output. It takes effect after a restart.
st_applied_fmt.translation: %s set on every PWM servo output. It takes effect after a restart.

st_digital_help.english: 333 Hz, check your servos support it.
st_digital_help.translation: 333 Hz, check your servos support it.

st_intro.english: What kind of servo drives the steering?
st_intro.translation: What kind of servo drives the steering?

sty_intro.english: Choose the style closest to how you drive. It sets how fast the car turns at full steering, and how the stabilizer's I-term behaves while you steer.
sty_intro.translation: Choose the style closest to how you drive. It sets how fast the car turns at full steering, and how the stabilizer's I-term behaves while you steer.

sty_more.english: Applies to steering in the current rate and PID profiles.
sty_more.translation: Applies to steering in the current rate and PID profiles.

sty_trainer_help.english: Beginners, scale cars and first runs.
sty_trainer_help.translation: Beginners, scale cars and first runs.

tg_auto_note.english: No trim channel: the wizard sets up no steering trim. A radio trim left on the steering is read as a steering input, which the stabilizer holds against.
tg_auto_note.translation: No trim channel: the wizard sets up no steering trim. A radio trim left on the steering is read as a steering input, which the stabilizer holds against.

tg_button_none_fmt.english: No trim button pressed (AUX %d reads %d us).
tg_button_none_fmt.translation: No trim button pressed (AUX %d reads %d us).

tg_buttons_check.english: Press each trim button: its name shows below. If one doesn't, check its weight in the TRIM mix.
tg_buttons_check.translation: Press each trim button: its name shows below. If one doesn't, check its weight in the TRIM mix.

tg_full.english: Every adjustment slot is in use. Free one on the Adjustments page.
tg_full.translation: Every adjustment slot is in use. Free one on the Adjustments page.

tg_gain_centre.english: Do the first run with it at center.
tg_gain_centre.translation: Do the first run with it at center.

tg_gain_q.english: A knob or slider to turn the stabilizer up or down while driving: up if the car wanders, down if it wobbles. Fully down is off, center 75%, fully up 150%.
tg_gain_q.translation: A knob or slider to turn the stabilizer up or down while driving: up if the car wanders, down if it wobbles. Fully down is off, center 75%, fully up 150%.

tg_how_buttons.english: On the radio: in Trims keep the steering trim. Keep the trim off the steering channel (a free mix from Steering with no trim). Add a free mix TRIM: always on, source Maximum, Add, output a spare channel, with an action per steering trim button at these weights: T1 CCW 30, T1 CW 40. Then press Detect and press any trim button.
tg_how_buttons.translation: On the radio: in Trims keep the steering trim. Keep the trim off the steering channel (a free mix from Steering with no trim). Add a free mix TRIM: always on, source Maximum, Add, output a spare channel, with an action per steering trim button at these weights: T1 CCW 30, T1 CW 40. Then press Detect and press any trim button.

tg_how_channels.english: On the radio: set the steering trim's step to Coarse. Keep the trim off the steering channel (a free mix from Steering with no trim). Add a free mix STEERING TRIM: always on, source the steering trim, Add, 100%, on a spare channel. Then press Detect and press the trim when asked.
tg_how_channels.translation: On the radio: set the steering trim's step to Coarse. Keep the trim off the steering channel (a free mix from Steering with no trim). Add a free mix STEERING TRIM: always on, source the steering trim, Add, 100%, on a spare channel. Then press Detect and press the trim when asked.

tg_intro.english: Two things you'll want on the first runs: a way to trim the steering, and a knob to turn the stabilizer gain up or down.
tg_intro.translation: Two things you'll want on the first runs: a way to trim the steering, and a knob to turn the stabilizer gain up or down.

tg_trim_q.english: How do you want to trim?
tg_trim_q.translation: How do you want to trim?

tg_turn_axis_knob_fmt.english: Turn the %s gain knob end to end...
tg_turn_axis_knob_fmt.translation: Turn the %s gain knob end to end...

tg_turn_knob.english: Turn the knob or slider end to end...
tg_turn_knob.translation: Turn the knob or slider end to end...

reload_prompt.english: Reload local run stats from the model file?
reload_prompt.translation: Reload local run stats from the model file?

save_prompt.english: Save local run stats and sync them to the controller?
save_prompt.translation: Save local run stats and sync them to the controller?

no_more_than_40.english: No more than 40 sensors can be enabled at once
no_more_than_40.translation: Er kunnen niet meer dan 40 sensoren tegelijk worden ingeschakeld

msg_background_task_missing_body.english: Gripora background task is not running. Enable it before opening menus.
msg_background_task_missing_body.translation: Gripora-achtergrondtaak wordt niet uitgevoerd. Schakel het in voordat u menu's opent.

msg_load_failed_body.english: Data could not be read from the controller. Please reload.
msg_load_failed_body.translation: Data could not be read from the controller. Please reload.

msg_please_disarm_to_save_warning.english: The controller rejected the save while armed. Your changes are safe and will be written to flash when you disarm.
msg_please_disarm_to_save_warning.translation: The controller rejected the save while armed. Your changes are safe and will be written to flash when you disarm.

msg_save_failed_body.english: Settings were not saved to the controller. Please try again.
msg_save_failed_body.translation: Settings were not saved to the controller. Please try again.

msg_save_failed_local_body.english: Settings were not saved to the radio. Please try again.
msg_save_failed_local_body.translation: Instellingen niet opgeslagen op de zender. Probeer het opnieuw.

msg_save_failed_model_body.english: The model's settings were not saved to the radio. Please try again.
msg_save_failed_model_body.translation: The model's settings were not saved to the radio. Please try again.

msg_unsaved_armed_body.english: Saving is locked while armed. Discard the changes?
msg_unsaved_armed_body.translation: Saving is locked while armed. Discard the changes?

msg_select_battery.english: Please select the battery you want to use:
msg_select_battery.translation: Selecteer de batterij die u wilt gebruiken:

write_failed.english: Battery profile could not be saved.

reset_flight_ask_text.english: Are you sure you want to reset the run?
reset_flight_ask_text.translation: Are you sure you want to reset the run?

startup_no_link_detail.english: Power the car and wait for telemetry.
startup_no_link_detail.translation: Power the car and wait for telemetry.
